title.narrative: Securing the future of labouring children in Karamoja &Busoga (SEFULAC) Project

description.narrative:
i. Relevance to the objective(s) and priority of the call for proposals:

SOS Children¿s Villages Uganda (SOS CV-UG) together with like-minded partners Share An Opportunity Uganda (SAO-UG) and Action for Humanitarian Initiatives Uganda (AFHI-U) seeks to implement an action to reduce and prevent child labour in Mayuge, Kaliro, Abim, and Amudat Districts located in Busoga and Karomoja regions of Uganda. The Overall Objective of the action is to contribute to the reduction of worst forms of child labour in the agricultural, mining, and commercial sexual exploitation sectors in Busoga and Karamoja Sub-regions in Uganda with two specific objectives:

·S.O 1: The capacity of children, families, communities and the child protection system to take action against child labour, including children¿s knowledge of their rights, is increased in the Districts of Mayuge, Kaliro, Abim, and Amudat by 2026.

·S.O 2: Access to social protection, and evidence-based services including livelihood support for promoting alternatives to child labour at national level and in the Districts of Mayuge, Kaliro, Abim, and Amudat is improved by 2026.
